summary: Small, targeted change in admin get_search_results that builds the per-term OR filter via an explicit Q() |= loop instead of the positional-tuple Q(*generator, _connector=OR) form, which is the join-reusing pattern needed to avoid the extra joins reported in the issue. Functionally correct (empty Q() is the OR-identity in Django, so the loop is equivalent to reduce(or_)) and passes the reproduction and regression suites.

issues.description: Replacing a single Q(...) expression with a mutable Q() plus in-place |= loop is slightly more verbose; a reduce(operator.or_, ...) or comprehension could express the same intent more idiomatically, but this form is clear and matches long-standing Django admin style.

No inline comment explaining that the loop form is intentional (join reuse / avoiding unnecessary JOINs); a one-line note would prevent a future refactor from reintroducing the generator/_connector form. Not merge-blocking.
